visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short beard and dark hair smiles and flashes a peace sign in a selfie-style close-up shot. He is wearing a white t-shirt featuring a colorful graphic. The background is a sunlit outdoor street with lush green trees and urban buildings under a clear blue sky. (2) The camera tilts up to focus on a black storefront sign with a yellow lightning bolt mascot and the text 'Mr. comedy 喜天電腦'. The building has a weathered tile facade. (3) Inside a computer shop, the creator reaches his hand out to greet a technician wearing glasses and a black t-shirt. The shop environment is cluttered with various computer hardware boxes and equipment. (4) A wide shot displays an array of MSI-branded computer components on a table, including a motherboard, a GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER graphics card, a liquid cooler, and a power supply. (5) A fast-paced montage shows hands assembling the computer: placing the CPU into the socket, securing the motherboard, mounting the liquid cooler fans, and plugging in power cables. (6) The completed PC is shown inside a black case with tempered glass panels. The internal fans and cooling block glow with vibrant, cycling RGB lighting in shades of purple, blue, and green. (7) The man is seen in a split-screen or overlay reacting to a video on a monitor. The video on the screen shows a bald man speaking. (8) In a night scene, the creator walks down a quiet residential street lit by streetlamps. He opens the trunk of a white SUV to reveal a large MSI monitor box. (9) The creator meets a friend with long, bleached-streak hair. They interact warmly in the street at night. (10) The final scene shows the friend sitting in his room, wearing headphones, and playing 'Monster Hunter' on the newly built PC, which is visible on his desk with its glowing lights.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Motivation -> Process -> Climax/Reveal -> Twist -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle vlog that documents the creator building a high-end gaming PC using MSI components. While it functions as a product showcase/endorsement, the narrative twist reveals the PC is actually a gift for a friend to ensure they can play 'Monster Hunter' together. It combines tech enthusiasm with a humorous, personal storyline.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed showcasing of specific computer parts with brand logos (MSI) and slogan overlays highlighting technical specs.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses typical social media editing styles with high-density text overlays and fast cuts to maintain engagement. The blend of commercial promotion and interpersonal narrative makes it a highly effective 'soft' advertisement.
